main_text.p: קנה Ch. & Syr. Comparare, emere, acquirere, acquisitum possidere, Ethpeh. Particip.
קנינא, קניא Ch. Syr. Emptio, acquisitio, possessio: substantia, opes, facultates, divitiæ. Pl. קנינין.
קנה, קנא, קני Chald. & Syr. Canna, calamus, culmus, arundo, calamus odoratus, aromaticus, calamus mensorius. Plur. קני, קנין.
קנאה, קינאה, קינאָרה Ch. Faber, conflator, aurifaber, argentarius: Syr. Faber ærarius, χαλκεύς, 2. ad Tim. 4.14. Plur. קינאי, קינאין Esth. 5.14.

קנינא Talmud. Venatores, Ex Græco κυνηγέω. Venor: Κυνηγός, Venator. Legitur & Esth. 1.2. in Tar. sec. sub finem illius versus, sed alio sensu. Elias explicat בעליצחוק. Videtur sumi pro Artificibus, Opificibus.
קנד Syr. Periculum, pericula, Respondet Græco κίνδυνω in sing. & plur. κινδύνοις, Act. 9.40. ad Rom. 8.35. 1. ad Cor. 15.30. & 2. 11.26.

קנט Ch. Irritare, incitare, concitare: quomodo convenit Græ. Κεντέω vel κνήθω: vel Affligere, ut sit idem quod נקט per Metathesin litterarum: Nam Exo. 22. 20. in Jon. respondet Hebræo תונה, & Numer 21.5. quod in Jon. dicitur נפשנא קנטת במנא, id in T.H. exprimitur per מעיקא. Deinde Syr. est Vitare, evitare,

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Greek words are transcribed as closely as the scan allows; several Syriac and Hebrew forms are doubtful, notably the Syriac vowel-pointed words and the Hebrew in the Jonah citations. The Syriac lines at the start of entries 2 and 4 are reproduced approximately.
